projects.name: AppleSkin
projects.summary: A port of AppleSkin by soufi (a port of AppleSkin by squeek502).
projects.description: A port of AppleSkin by soufi (a port of AppleSkin by squeek502). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Shows your saturation over the food bar as a text bar, and what the food in your hand would restore: +hunger and +saturation, and the totals after eating. The exhaustion strip is not shown: the client has no exhaustion value to read. /appleskin hides or shows the panel; Options > Mods has the saturation line, the held-food preview and the position.

versions.changelog: AppleSkin 0.1.0 — live saturation display and held-food hunger/saturation preview. A port of AppleSkin by soufi (a port of AppleSkin by squeek502). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. The exhaustion strip is not included: the client has no exhaustion value to read.

projects.name: Armor Status
projects.summary: Equipped armour and held items with Java durability colours on the HUD.
projects.description: Equipped armour and held items with Java durability colours on the HUD: all four armour slots plus the main hand and the off hand, green above 50%, yellow from 25%, orange from 10%, red below 10%. /armor hides or shows the panel; Options > Mods has position, durability format, hand items and stack counts. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

versions.changelog:
Armor Status as a .kmod for Kestrel.

Equipped armour and held items with Java durability colours on the HUD: all four armour slots plus the main hand and the off hand, green above 50%, yellow from 25%, orange from 10%, red below 10%. Stack counts for held items that don't wear out. /armor hides or shows the panel; Options > Mods has position, durability format, hand items and stack counts.

Port of CayMac97's Armor Status (MIT). Known gaps (SDK limits): text lines only, no item icons; corners only, no hotbar-adjacent positions; no translucent background box. Source: mods/armor-status/ in this repo.

Needs a Kestrel build with the inventory SDK (API level 9) as in kestrel-build-4. Import the .kmod, enable it in the Mods list, enter a world.

projects.name: Armor HUD
projects.summary: Your worn armor and its durability in a column at the bottom-left of the screen.
projects.description: Your worn armor and its durability in a column at the bottom-left of the screen. K shows or hides the durability numbers; a piece about to break flashes. Both switches are also in Options > Mods > Armor HUD. A behaviour port of Armor HUD by Thomas9950; this port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/armor-hud Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

versions.changelog:
Armor HUD as a .kmod for Kestrel.

Your worn armor and its durability in a column at the bottom-left of the screen. K shows or hides the durability numbers (off by default, chat confirms ON/OFF); a piece about to break flashes. Both switches are also in Options > Mods > Armor HUD.

Port of Armor HUD by Thomas9950 (MIT). Known gaps (SDK limits): text-line panel only, no item icons and no pixel position left of the off-hand slot — the column is anchored bottom-left; the toggle notice goes to chat instead of a fading notice above the hotbar. Source: mods/armor-hud/ in this repo.

Needs a Kestrel build with the inventory SDK (API level 9) as in kestrel-build-4. Import the .kmod, enable it in the Mods list, enter a world.

projects.name: The Basic HUD
projects.summary: A port of The Basic HUD by repositorykreml1n.
projects.description: A port of The Basic HUD by repositorykreml1n. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. A corner HUD panel: coordinates, FPS, clock, speed, CPS, player health, held-item and armour durability, and recent pickups. /basichud hides or shows the panel; Options > Mods has a switch per widget, the corner, and the pickup display time. Effect timers, item cooldowns, ping, the Tab list, the drag-and-drop editor, totem-use counting and the ten interface languages are not in this port: the SDK does not expose what they need. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/basic-hud

versions.changelog:
Basic HUD 0.1.0 (partial) — a corner HUD panel: coordinates, FPS, clock, speed, CPS, player health, held-item and armour durability, and recent pickups. /basichud hides or shows the panel; Options > Mods has a switch per widget, the corner, and the pickup display time.

A port of The Basic HUD by repositorykreml1n. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

Not in this port: effect timers, item cooldowns, ping, the Tab list, the drag-and-drop HUD editor, totem-use counting and the ten interface languages — none of that is exposed by the SDK. Per-widget position, scale, colours, opacity, padding and shadows are not in this port either; the SDK HUD is plain text lines in one corner.

Runs on Kestrel build 9+ (API level 9).

projects.name: Blockscope
projects.summary: A port of Blockscope by Domanffe.
projects.description: A port of Blockscope by Domanffe. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. The block under your crosshair — its name in your language, its id, its distance and its coordinates — in a small box in the top-right corner. /blockscope hides or shows the box; Options > Mods has the same switch, a coordinates switch and a reach switch (5, 20, 64 or 128 blocks). This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/blockscope

versions.changelog: Blockscope 0.1.1: the reach switch gains a 128-block step — 5, 20, 64 or 128 blocks — in Options > Mods > Blockscope. Import blockscope.kmod in Kestrel; it runs on any current build (SDK API level 5).

projects.name: Classic Zoom
projects.summary: Hold V to zoom 3x, scroll while holding V to zoom 1x-10x (x1.1 per wheel step), release to snap back instantly.
projects.description: Hold V to zoom 3x, scroll while holding V to zoom 1x-10x (x1.1 per wheel step), release to snap back instantly. While V is held the wheel zooms instead of switching hotbar slots, and turning slows in step with the zoom. The key is rebindable on the mod's page in Options > Mods. A behaviour port of Classic Zoom by SU4G3; this port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/classic-zoom Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

versions.changelog:
Classic Zoom as a .kmod for Kestrel.

Hold V to zoom 3x, scroll while holding to zoom 1x-10x (x1.1 per wheel step), release to snap back instantly. While V is held the wheel zooms instead of switching hotbar slots, and turning slows in step with the zoom. Rebindable on the mod's page in Options > Mods.

Behaviour port of Classic Zoom by SU4G3 (original GPL-3.0; no original code copied). Source: mods/classic-zoom/ in this repo.

Needs a Kestrel build with the SDK as in kestrel-build-4. Import the .kmod, enable it in the Mods list, enter a world.

projects.name: Compass Bar
projects.summary: A behaviour port of Compass Enhanced by Isaac (Fernandes585), MIT (https://github.com/Fernandes585/Compass-Enhanced).
projects.description: A behaviour port of Compass Enhanced by Isaac (Fernandes585), MIT (https://github.com/Fernandes585/Compass-Enhanced). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. A compass bar across the top of the screen: the eight compass letters (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW) in one colour and a degree scale, sliding smoothly as you turn. Options > Mods > Compass Bar holds the original's settings: the bar on/off, the background box, the size (75% to 150%) and the letter colour. The original's death points are NOT included: the client SDK exposes no death event, so there is nothing to hang a death marker on yet — they arrive when the SDK gains one, and the death-point settings go with them. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/compass_bar

versions.changelog: Behaviour port of Compass Enhanced by Isaac (MIT): a compass bar across the top of the screen with coloured direction letters and a degree scale, with the original's settings (bar on/off, background, size, letter colour). Death points are not included: the client SDK exposes no death event yet.

projects.name: Coordinates HUD
projects.summary: Your coordinates, facing and the time of day in a corner of the screen.
projects.description: Your coordinates, facing and the time of day in a corner of the screen. /where puts them in chat, /coords hides or shows the panel — and the game keeps your choice. Options > Mods has the same switch. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

versions.changelog:
Coordinates HUD as a .kmod for Kestrel.

Top-left HUD panel: block position, facing direction, and time of day (Day N, HH:MM — restored; the native 2.0.0 dropped it, the Kestrel SDK clock allows it). /where puts coords + dimension in chat. /coords hides/shows the panel and the choice persists. Options > Mods has the same Shown ON/OFF switch.

Port of Horizon's native Coordinates HUD 2.0.0 (MIT). Source: mods/coords-hud/ in this repo.

Needs a Kestrel build with the SDK as in kestrel-build-4. Import the .kmod, enable it in the Mods list, enter a world.

projects.name: Crosshair Indicator
projects.summary: Your crosshair tells you when the mob or player you aim at is within attack reach (3 blocks).
projects.description: Your crosshair tells you when the mob or player you aim at is within attack reach (3 blocks). Corner brackets, a centre dot, diamond pips or a chevron above the crosshair, in white, red, pink, cyan or gold. A port of Crosshair Indicator by CayMac (Java original by AmerDz01); this port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/crosshair-indicator Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

versions.changelog:
Crosshair Indicator 0.1.0 — your crosshair tells you when the mob or player you aim at is within attack reach (3 blocks). Four styles (corner brackets, centre dot, diamond pips, chevron) in five static colours. Settings in Options > Mods; /crosshair toggles it.

A port of Crosshair Indicator by CayMac (Java original by AmerDz01). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

Not in this port: the weapon-cooldown bar and the dynamic charge colours — weapon attack strength is not exposed by the SDK.

Runs on Kestrel build 9+ (API level 10).

projects.name: Beautiful Day Counter
projects.summary: The current survival day, an in-game clock and a day/night cycle bar with four colour themes, the moon phase and a countdown to night or day.
projects.description: The current survival day, an in-game clock and a day/night cycle bar with four colour themes, the moon phase and a countdown to night or day. Settings on its page in Options > Mods. A port of SCARABOCCHIO100 / sonoFrangu's CustomHUD; milestone days show a rainbow badge (the SDK has no audio, so no milestone sound plays). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

versions.changelog:
Beautiful Day Counter as a .kmod for Kestrel.

Current survival day, in-game clock (12h/24h), day/night cycle bar in four colour themes, moon phase, and countdown to night/day. Settings page in Options > Mods (theme, clock format, corner, element toggles). /daycounter prints a chat summary.

Port of SCARABOCCHIO100 / sonoFrangu's CustomHUD (MIT). Known gap: milestone days show a rainbow badge but play no sound — the SDK has no audio capability. Source: mods/customhud/ in this repo.

Needs a Kestrel build with the SDK as in kestrel-build-4. Import the .kmod, enable it in the Mods list, enter a world.

projects.name: FPS Counter
projects.summary: A port of Horizon's own FPS Counter (MIT), formerly a built-in extra, for Kestrel by NepThunder.
projects.description: A port of Horizon's own FPS Counter (MIT), formerly a built-in extra, for Kestrel by NepThunder. Frames per second in a small box in a corner of the screen, with the slowest frame and the 1% low of the last 5 seconds if you turn them on. Options > Mods > FPS Counter sets the corner and the minimum and 1% low — the original's two settings, with its defaults (top left, minimum and 1% low off). This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/fps_overlay

versions.changelog: Behaviour port of Horizon's FPS Counter (MIT): current FPS in a corner, with the original's combined min / 1% low toggle (off by default) and its exact text format.

projects.name: Freecam
projects.summary: A port of Freecam by hakergeniusz (a rewrite of Freecam by the Freecam authors).
projects.description: A port of Freecam by hakergeniusz (a rewrite of Freecam by the Freecam authors). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Press Y (or /freecam) to detach the camera: fly it on dedicated keys — I forward, comma back, semicolon left, apostrophe right, equal up, minus down — while your player stays where they were, and the mouse looks around. Options > Mods > Freecam has the same switch plus the fly-speed switch (2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40 or 60 blocks/s); the game keeps the speed. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/freecam

versions.changelog: No HUD notice while detached — the toggle answers in chat only. The fly-speed switch now cycles 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40 or 60 blocks/s.

projects.name: Freelook
projects.summary: A port of Freelook by Krzysix17.
projects.description: A port of Freelook by Krzysix17. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Hold X (or /freelook) to look around freely while your character keeps walking and facing the way it was; let go and the camera snaps back. Options > Mods > Freelook switches hold and toggle. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/freelook

versions.changelog:
Freelook 0.1.0 — a port of Freelook by Krzysix17.

Hold X (or /freelook) to look around freely while your character keeps walking and facing the way it was; let go and the camera snaps back. Options > Mods > Freelook switches hold and toggle.

Requires Kestrel build 24 or newer (camera API, level 14). Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.

Note: this port keeps the camera at the eye and only decouples the look — the original's third-person orbit (camera pulled out behind the player) is not in this version.

projects.name: Fullbright
projects.summary: A port of Fullbright by CayMac.
projects.description: A port of Fullbright by CayMac. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Press J (or /fullbright) to toggle maximum brightness (1000% gamma) with a one-second fade; Options > Mods > Fullbright has the same switch and the fade switch. The game keeps your choices. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/fullbright

versions.changelog:
Fullbright 0.1.0 — a port of Fullbright by CayMac.

Press J (or /fullbright) to toggle maximum brightness (1000% gamma) with a one-second fade. Options > Mods > Fullbright has the same switch plus a fade switch; your choices are kept.

Requires Kestrel build 19 or newer (gamma API, level 13). Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.

Notes: the fade steps once per tick, not per frame. Gamma 10.0 saturates toward white, so colours wash out a little compared with the Extras fullbright switch. While this mod is loaded it holds your Brightness value, so the Options Brightness slider looks dead until the mod is disabled — disabling it restores your setting right away.

projects.name: Fullbright & NoFog
projects.summary: A port of Fullbright & NoFog by Nirokx.
projects.description: A port of Fullbright & NoFog by Nirokx. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Press B (or /fullbright-nofog) to fade to maximum brightness (gamma 10.0, the 1000% Fullbright value) and remove distance fog — the Nether's 96-block fog wall included; press it again to fade back to your own Brightness and turn fog back on. Options > Mods > Fullbright & NoFog has the same switch plus a fade switch; the game keeps your choices. Works in singleplayer and multiplayer. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/fullbright-nofog

versions.changelog:
Fullbright & NoFog 0.1.0 — a port of Fullbright & NoFog by Nirokx.

Press B (or /fullbright-nofog) to fade to maximum brightness (gamma 10.0, the 1000% Fullbright value) and remove distance fog — the Nether's 96-block fog wall included. Press it again to fade back to your own Brightness and turn fog back on. Options > Mods > Fullbright & NoFog has the same switch plus a fade switch; your choices are kept.

Requires Kestrel build 19 or newer (gamma and fog API, level 13). Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.

Notes: only distance fog is removed — water, lava and powder-snow fog, blindness, darkness and boss fog stay. The fade steps once per tick, not per frame. While this mod is loaded it holds your Brightness value, so the Options Brightness slider looks dead until the mod is disabled — disabling it restores your setting right away.

projects.name: Gyro
projects.summary: A port of Gyro by CGRLabs, inspired by Do a Barrel Roll.
projects.description: A port of Gyro by CGRLabs, inspired by Do a Barrel Roll. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. While you glide, the camera banks and rolls with your look: move the mouse and the horizon tilts, up to a full barrel roll when you look right round; the view eases back to level when you stop gliding. Y toggles it (rebindable), /gyro shows the roll and speed, /gyro on and /gyro off set it. Camera only: the flight itself stays vanilla, so this port cannot steer the glide — while it is on, the mouse turns the camera, not you, and your glide holds its heading. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/gyro

versions.changelog:
Gyro 0.1.0 — a port of Gyro by CGRLabs, inspired by Do a Barrel Roll.

While you glide, the camera banks and rolls with your look: move the mouse and the horizon tilts, up to a full barrel roll when you look right round; the view eases back to level when you stop gliding. Y toggles it (rebindable), /gyro shows the roll and speed, /gyro on and /gyro off set it.

Requires Kestrel build 24 or newer (camera API, level 14). Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.

Note: camera only — the flight itself stays vanilla, so this port cannot steer the glide. While it is on, the mouse turns the camera, not you, and your glide holds its heading.

projects.name: Held Item Info
projects.summary: The selected item's remaining/maximum durability, stack count and up to six enchantment names on the HUD.
projects.description: The selected item's remaining/maximum durability, stack count and up to six enchantment names on the HUD: one line for the held item, nothing when it has nothing to say. /helditem hides or shows the line, and Options > Mods has the same switch. A port of Held Item Info by AltMugen. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/held-item-info

versions.changelog: Held Item Info 0.1.0 — selected-item durability, stack count and enchantment names on the HUD. A port of Held Item Info by AltMugen. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

projects.name: Hitbox+
projects.summary: A port of Hitbox+ by taxtii and itzglecni.
projects.description: A port of Hitbox+ by taxtii and itzglecni. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Customizable entity hitboxes: a box takes bright green while your crosshair is on a mob within attack reach (3 blocks, 4.5 for a spear), in your choice of four colours and three thicknesses, with a red eye-level band and a blue look-direction arrow per mob. H toggles the boxes (rebindable), and Options > Mods > Hitbox+ has the same switch plus colour, thickness, eye ray, sprint display and sprint position; the game keeps your choices. A sprint indicator shows in the corner you pick. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/hitbox-plus

versions.changelog:
Hitbox+ 0.1.0 — customizable entity hitboxes: bright green while the mob under your crosshair is within attack reach (3 blocks, 4.5 for a spear), four colours, three thicknesses, a red eye band and a blue look arrow per mob, plus a sprint indicator. H or /hitbox toggles it; settings in Options > Mods.

A port of Hitbox+ by taxtii and itzglecni. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

Not in this port: boxes round non-living entities (dropped items, boats, paintings and the rest) — the entity API lists living mobs only; the exact eye height per mob and the mob's true look direction (no eye height or pitch exposed); creative-mode reach and the true sprinting/swimming state (no game mode or sprint state exposed); the eleven reach colours and rainbow style from the registry blurb (the shipped 1.3.0 source has one in-reach colour and four styles).

Runs on Kestrel build 17+ (API level 11).

projects.name: Jade
projects.summary: A port of Jade by Snownee and Joeypc6 (block and entity identification).
projects.description: A port of Jade by Snownee and Joeypc6 (block and entity identification). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Look at a block or a mob to see what it is — a block's name, its mod, its position and how far away it is, or a mob's name, its kind, its health and how far away it is — in a panel at the top-left; /jade hides or shows it, and Options > Mods has the same switch. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/jade

versions.changelog:
Jade 0.2.0 — entity tooltips join the block tooltip: look at a mob to see its name, its kind, its health and how far away it is, in the same top-left panel. In multiplayer the panel shows name, kind and distance with no health line — health is not synced to clients in v1. The block half is unchanged: name, mod, position, distance, reach switch 6/20/64.

A port of Jade by Snownee and Joeypc6 (block and entity identification). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

Still not in this port: entity health in multiplayer, block states/progress, provider plugins, themes, the /jadec command and the game rule.

Runs on Kestrel build 9+ (API level 10).

projects.name: JEI for Horizon
projects.summary: An item and recipe viewer: every item beside container screens, with search (words, "quoted phrases", -exclusions, | alternatives, @namespace, #tag).
projects.description: An item and recipe viewer: every item beside container screens, with search (words, "quoted phrases", -exclusions, | alternatives, @namespace, #tag). R over an item shows its recipes, U its uses, with a tab per station and cooking time and XP; Back walks the history, and + fills the crafting grid with a recipe you know. In creative mode a click can give you the item (Mod settings or /jei give). /jei reports the recipe table sizes. A port of JEI for Horizon 0.1.0 by enderliker (MIT), inspired by JustEnoughItems. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

versions.changelog:
JEI for Horizon as a .kmod for Kestrel — the original's 0.1.0 Core Viewer.

0.1.1 fixes the world-load "took too long" stop: the recipe/item tables now load a slice per tick (~0.5s) instead of all at once in a single frame.

Item browser beside container screens with JEI search grammar (words, quoted phrases, -exclusions, | alternatives, #tag). R shows an item's recipes, U its uses, with a tab per station, cooking time and XP. Back walks history, clicking a recipe slot opens that item, + fills the crafting grid with a known recipe. /jei reports table sizes; /jei give (or the settings toggle) lets clicks give items in creative.

Port of JEI for Horizon 0.1.0 by enderliker (MIT). Out of scope: bookmarks, tooltips, creative inventory integration, non-recipe categories, shift-click placement. Source: mods/jei/ in this repo.

Needs a Kestrel build with the SDK as in kestrel-build-4 or later. Import the .kmod, enable it in the Mods list, enter a world.

projects.name: Keystrokes
projects.summary: A port of Horizon's own Keystrokes overlay (MIT), formerly a built-in extra, for Kestrel by NepThunder.
projects.description: A port of Horizon's own Keystrokes overlay (MIT), formerly a built-in extra, for Kestrel by NepThunder. Your movement keys as you bound them, the two mouse buttons and the space bar in a corner, lit while held, with clicks per second under each mouse button. Options > Mods > Keystrokes sets the corner and turns clicks per second off or on — the original's two settings, with its defaults (top left, clicks per second on). This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/keystrokes

versions.changelog: Behaviour port of Horizon's Keystrokes overlay (MIT): movement keys, mouse buttons and space bar light while held, with clicks-per-second under each mouse button. Settings: corner and CPS toggle, same as the original.

projects.name: KillC
projects.summary: A behaviour port of KillC by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12.
projects.description: A behaviour port of KillC by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. /killc and /suicide kill you; /killc <player> kills another player. Each is the vanilla kill command run as you, with your permissions — the original is a server plugin whose word is law, this port asks the server, so a server that denies you the kill denies the command (see the README's gap list). The original's random respawn near (0, 0) is on with the original's radius of 100, and follows the kill: you are teleported to a random surface spot right away, which is also where a denied kill leaves the feature (the teleport runs with the same permissions). /killc config on|off|random on|off and /killc radius <blocks> hold the original's config (config/killc.json's enabled, useRandomSpawn, randomSpawnRadius). This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/killc

versions.changelog: Behaviour port of KillC by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12: /killc, /suicide and /killc <player>, run as you with your permissions, with the original's config (enabled, random respawn, radius 100).

projects.name: Light Overlay
projects.summary: A port of Light Overlay by CayMac.
projects.description: A port of Light Overlay by CayMac. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Press F7 (or /lightoverlay) to scan the block tops around you and mark where hostile mobs can spawn: a red cross where they can spawn any time, a yellow cross where they can spawn at night. Options > Mods > Light Overlay has the same switch, a scan-radius switch (8, 12, 16 or 20 blocks), a safe-blocks switch and the spawn-rule switch (Modern or Legacy). This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/light-overlay

versions.changelog:
Light Overlay 0.1.0 — red crosses where hostile mobs can spawn at any time, yellow crosses where they can spawn at night, over the block tops around you. F7 or /lightoverlay toggles it; settings in Options > Mods (radius 8/12/16/20, safe blocks, Modern/Legacy spawn rule).

A port of Light Overlay by CayMac. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

Not in this port: the light level as a number on the block top — no world-text capability yet, so crosses only, with the counts in the corner panel; surfaces under leaves, torches or tall grass get no cross (a mob needs head room); multiplayer shows nothing (world reads are singleplayer-only in v1).

Runs on Kestrel build 18+ (API level 12).

projects.name: LookAt
projects.summary: A port of LookAt by d3grando.
projects.description: A port of LookAt by d3grando. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. The block or mob under your crosshair as a tooltip at the top of the screen: its name in your language, the namespace it comes from, its position and distance — and for a mob, its health as hearts and numbers. /lookat hides or shows it; Options > Mods has the range (6, 20, 64, 256 or 1024 blocks), position, health and entities switches. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/lookat

versions.changelog:
LookAt 0.1.0 — the block or mob under your crosshair as a tooltip at the top of the screen: its name in your language, the namespace it comes from, its position and distance — and for a mob, its health as hearts and numbers. /lookat hides or shows it; Options > Mods has the range (6, 20, 64, 256 or 1024 blocks), position, health and entities switches.

A port of LookAt by d3grando. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

Not in this port: the item icon (the SDK HUD is a text panel), the harvest-tool check (the harvest rule is not exposed), and non-living entities like boats and armor stands (the v1 entity API covers living mobs only).

Runs on Kestrel build 9+ (API level 10).

projects.name: MoreGamma
projects.summary: A port of MoreGamma by bezi5kt.
projects.description: A port of MoreGamma by bezi5kt. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Set the brightness (gamma) far past the video settings' 100% "Bright" limit with /gamma <value> — 1 is vanilla's "Bright", 10 is fullbright, the brightest the SDK allows — or toggle full brightness with /fullbright; /gamma on its own shows the gamma in effect, /gamma reset (or off) goes back to your Brightness setting, and /gamma on turns your last custom gamma on again. Your Brightness setting and options.txt are never changed. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/moregamma

versions.changelog:
MoreGamma 0.1.0 — a port of MoreGamma by bezi5kt.

Set the brightness (gamma) far past the video settings' 100% "Bright" limit: /gamma <value> — 1 is vanilla's "Bright", 10 is fullbright, the brightest the SDK allows. /gamma on its own shows the gamma in effect; /gamma reset (or off) goes back to your Brightness setting; /gamma on turns your last custom gamma on again. /fullbright toggles gamma 10.0. Percentages work too: /gamma 1500% is 15, clamped to 10.

Requires Kestrel build 19 or newer (gamma API, level 13). Works in singleplayer and multiplayer. Your Brightness setting and options.txt are never changed.

projects.name: Punchy
projects.summary: A behaviour port of Punchy! by PunchyDevGuy (All Rights Reserved; no code or assets copied — the feel reimplemented against the Kestrel SDK).
projects.description: A behaviour port of Punchy! by PunchyDevGuy (All Rights Reserved; no code or assets copied — the feel reimplemented against the Kestrel SDK). The first-person hand lags behind your look on a spring, attacks with authored animations — a sword slash and a spear jab replace the vanilla swing, and other swings keep part of it with a follow-through on top — and bobs with more weight. Options > Mods > Punchy sets the intensity and which parts run, and /punchy reports them. First-person only; the original's resource pack and third-person changes are out of scope. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/punchy

versions.changelog: Rebuilt around what the original Punchy! actually does, from its own page and gameplay loops. Sword swings now chain into combos — chained swings alternate forehand and backhand. Each tool has its own stroke: a pickaxe swings forward, an axe chops in from the side, a shovel digs down-forward and holds part of its depth between strokes while you keep digging. And every attack now settles home with a small overshoot instead of easing stiffly to a stop. Sway and bob unchanged. Needs SDK API 17 (dev build 30+).

projects.name: PVP Music
projects.summary: A behaviour port of PvP Music by Countered (CC0-1.0), via the Horizon port by sparticle62ops.
projects.description: A behaviour port of PvP Music by Countered (CC0-1.0), via the Horizon port by sparticle62ops. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. The original plays battle tracks during combat from a companion sound pack; this port keeps the original's combat detection — mutual combat remembered for 5 s, a wither within 30 blocks starts a fight — and reports the battle state with /pvpmusic, but the SDK cannot inject or switch music tracks, so no battle music plays in this port (see the README's gap list). Detection is single-player only in v1: the SDK's entity list is. /pvpmusic reports the state and the tracked fights. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/pvp_music

versions.changelog: Behaviour port of PvP Music by Countered (CC0-1.0), via the Horizon port by sparticle62ops. This release carries the original's combat detection (mutual-combat window, hurt/wither ranges) and /pvpmusic state. The battle tracks themselves are not included: the SDK cannot start or switch music tracks yet — that gap is documented in the mod, not substituted.

projects.name: RMotd
projects.summary: A behaviour port of RMotd by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12.
projects.description: A behaviour port of RMotd by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. The original rotates the MOTD of a world opened to LAN every 10 seconds, managed in game with /randommotd and /motd, from the list in config/rmotd.json. This port keeps the list — one MOTD per line in the mod's storage file 'motds' — and the commands (/randommotd on/off, /motd, /motd create <name> <motd>, /motd reload), with the rotation running on the same 10-second beat and the current MOTD shown in chat as it changes; but the SDK has no LAN-server or MOTD surface, so nothing writes the server list's MOTD (see the README's gap list). This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/rmotd

versions.changelog: Behaviour port of RMotd by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12: MOTD list managed in game with /randommotd, /motd, /motd create and /motd reload, rotating every 10 seconds. The LAN MOTD itself cannot be written from the SDK yet, so rotation is announced in your own chat — documented in the mod.

projects.name: SmartF3
projects.summary: A port of SmartF3 by d3grando.
projects.description: A port of SmartF3 by d3grando. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. A tidier, configurable F3 debug screen: FPS, coordinates, facing, world (dimension and clock), light at the player's feet (block and sky light, with the night-spawn verdict), player (health and food) and the targeted block and entity in one panel in the top-left corner. /smartf3 hides or shows the panel; Options > Mods has a switch per module. Biome, chunk, system, rendering, server, fluid and chart-keys modules are not exposed by the SDK and are not in this port. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/smartf3

versions.changelog:
SmartF3 0.2.0 — the Light module joins the panel: the block and sky light at the player's feet, one one-position `world.get-lights` call per tick, with the night-spawn verdict in the Overworld (`can spawn at night` where `max(block, sky - 11) <= 7`, `safe at night` elsewhere). Where no light is read — an unloaded or unlit chunk, or multiplayer — the line reads `Light: unknown`, never a guessed number. It is a per-module switch like the others, in Options > Mods > SmartF3.

A port of SmartF3 by d3grando. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

Everything else is unchanged: FPS, coordinates, facing, world (dimension and clock), player (health and food) and the targeted block and entity, with a switch per module.

Runs on Kestrel build 18+ (API level 12). The Light module is singleplayer-only; in multiplayer it reads `Light: unknown`.

Still not in this port: biome, chunk, system, rendering, server, fluid and chart-keys modules.

projects.name: Sound Physics
projects.summary: A behaviour port of Sound Physics Remastered by henkelmax (GPL-3.0).
projects.description: A behaviour port of Sound Physics Remastered by henkelmax (GPL-3.0). Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. Sounds are quietened and muffled by the blocks between you and them, and caves and enclosed spaces give them reverb. Options > Mods > Sound Physics sets the reverb amount and the occlusion strength, and /soundphysics reports the enclosure estimate around you. Single-player only in v1: the SDK's world reads are. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/sound_physics

versions.changelog: Fix: the enclosure probe no longer counts the ground. It cast in 26 directions including straight down, so the earth under you always counted as enclosure — open ground read about 35% and reverb followed you outdoors. The probe now casts only the 17 directions at or above eye level: walls and ceilings enclose a sound, the floor does not. Open sky now reads about 0%; caves and rooms read as before or higher. No other change; works on the same builds as 0.1.0 (SDK API 15).

projects.name: Speedrun Timer
projects.summary: A port of Speedrun Timer by Demerobit.
projects.description: A port of Speedrun Timer by Demerobit. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. An RTA timer in a corner of the screen, HH:MM:SS.mmm with live milliseconds: starts on your first move after a world loads, stops when you take the exit portal back from the End, keeps counting when you die, resets when you leave a world, and saves every finished run and your personal best. /speedrun, /speedrun start, /speedrun stop, /speedrun reset. Options > Mods has the corner, the shown and personal-best switches, and a button to view the saved runs. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/speedrun-timer

versions.changelog:
Speedrun Timer 0.1.0 — an RTA timer in a corner of the screen: HH:MM:SS.mmm with live milliseconds. It starts on your first move after a world loads, stops when you take the exit portal back from the End, keeps counting when you die, resets when you leave a world, and saves every finished run and your personal best — view them from Options > Mods > Speedrun Timer. /speedrun, /speedrun start, /speedrun stop, /speedrun reset; the corner, shown and personal-best switches are in the settings page.

A port of Speedrun Timer by Demerobit. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder.

Still not in this port: the exact auto start/stop edge cases the original gets from world-load and portal events — start/stop here are inferred from movement and dimension changes and can misfire at the edges (loading into a world already moving, or leaving the End without the portal); the in-game folder button (replaced by the saved-runs view); the original's own translucent box (the SDK panel is plain text).

Runs on Kestrel build 9+ (API level 10).

projects.name: Stuck?
projects.summary: A behaviour port of Stuck? by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12.
projects.description: A behaviour port of Stuck? by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. /stuck and /escape search random columns near you for solid ground with two blocks of air above — skipping lava, fire, magma, cactus and the other hazards, and leaves and snow — and move you there; a player on the Nether's bedrock roof is brought back under it; a 30-second cooldown runs between uses, as the original's default config sets. The search reads the world through the SDK, so it works in single player; the move is the vanilla teleport command run as you, with your permissions, where the original is a server plugin that simply moves you (see the README's gap list). This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/stuck

versions.changelog: Behaviour port of Stuck? by adasjusk (CC-BY-SA-4.0), via the Horizon port by Vakarux12: /stuck and /escape find safe ground nearby (hazards skipped, Nether-roof case handled) and teleport you there as yourself; 30-second cooldown, the original's default.

projects.name: Waypoints
projects.summary: Place waypoints with N, manage them with M, and see their distance on the HUD, a box and beam at each one in the world, and an in-world label with its name and distance at its position..
projects.description: Place waypoints with N, manage them with M, and see their distance on the HUD, a box and beam at each one in the world, and an in-world label with its name and distance at its position. N creates a waypoint where you stand (auto-named, coloured from the palette); M lists them with All / Overworld / Nether / End filters, Hide/Show, colour cycling, Move here and Delete; /wp renames, moves, recolours and deletes. Dying can leave a red Death waypoint where it happened. A port of Waypoints by Nirokx. Ported for Kestrel by NepThunder. This port's home is https://github.com/NepThunder/Kestrel-mods/tree/main/mods/waypoints

versions.changelog:
Waypoints 0.2.0 — in-world name/distance labels, on top of the 0.1.1 waypoint mod by Nirokx.

Each waypoint now shows its name and distance floating just above its box in the world, in the waypoint's colour (for example "Home · 21 m"). The label vanishes when the waypoint is behind the camera, and hides with the markers switch and with the HUD.

Requires Kestrel build 24 or newer (camera API, level 14). Works in singleplayer and multiplayer. Everything from 0.1.1 is unchanged: N creates a waypoint, M opens the list, /wp commands, death waypoints, settings.

Note: labels show through walls by design (same as the panel distance).
